title: AxoCore
description: AxoCore is a lightweight, high-performance core designed to unify essential commands across Minecraft networks, proxies, and multi-threaded servers like Folia. It serves as an efficient, single-JAR replacement for heavy, traditional command suites.
body:
# 🌌 AxoCore – The Ultimate Multi-Platform Core > ⚠️ **WARNING:** This plugin is currently in active development. It may contain bugs or unstable features. Please report any issues on our official issue tracker.

AxoCore is the ultimate solution for high-performance Minecraft networks.
Designed from the ground up to be lightweight, modular, and natively compatible with distributed environments.

--- ## 🚀 Why choose AxoCore? AxoCore was born to replace heavy, monolithic suites. Using a "Universal JAR" architecture with automatic environment detection, AxoCore adapts to the platform it is running on, executing only the necessary processes to maximize CPU and RAM efficiency. ### Key Features * ⚡ **Industrial-Grade Performance**: Native integration with **FoliaLib** to safely handle multi-threaded tasks on Folia and Paper. * 📦 **Single JAR Deployment**: Forget about managing multiple files. Use one single JAR for your proxies and your backend servers. * 🛡️ **Network-Ready**: Data synchronization via unified database (MySQL/MariaDB/SQLite). * 🎛️ **Full Modularity**: Disable any command or feature in `config.yml` to minimize your system footprint. * 🎨 **MiniMessage Support**: Modern gradient and styling support for all system messages. --- ## 🏗️ Compatibility Matrix | Environment | Node | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Proxy** | Velocity / BungeeCord | Network management, Global Moderation, Proxy Chat. | | **Backend** | Paper / Purpur / Folia | Local teleportation, Economy, Utilities, Kits. | --- ## 🕹️ System Commands These commands allow you to manage the plugin settings efficiently. | Command | Alias (Backend) | Alias (Proxy) | Function | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/axocore help` | `/axo`, `/axc` | `/axov`, `/axcv` | Displays this help menu. | | `/axocore reload`| `/axo reload` | `/axov reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration files. | --- ## 🛠️ Functional Commands ### 🌐 Proxy Commands (Network Management) * `/msg `: Send a private message across the network. * `/r `: Reply to the last received whisper. * `/staffchat `: Secure staff-only communication channel. * `/ban` / `/mute` / `/kick`: Synchronized network-wide moderation. * `/glist`: Real-time global player counts per server. * `/find `: Locate which subserver a player is currently in. ### 🏠 Backend Commands (World Interaction) * `/home` / `/sethome` / `/delhome`: Home point management. * `/warp` / `/setwarp`: Public network warp points. * `/spawn`: Return to the server's spawn point. * `/back`: Return to your previous location after teleporting. * `/vanish`: Become invisible to other players. * `/fly`: Toggle flight mode. * `/heal` / `/feed`: Restore health and saturation. * `/kit`: Claim serialized system kits. --- ## ⚙️ Installation & Configuration 1. **Deployment**: Place the `axocore-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` file into the `/plugins/` folder of **all** your servers (Proxies and Backends). 2. **Auto-Detection**: Upon startup, the plugin will automatically detect if it is running on a Proxy or a Backend and initialize the appropriate module. 3. **Configuration**: - Edit `config.yml` to toggle features. - Configure your database credentials (MySQL recommended) to sync homes and logs across servers. 4. **Permissions**: All commands require the node `axocore.command.`. (e.g., `axocore.command.home`). --- ## 🆘 Troubleshooting * **Plugin not detecting the Proxy?**: Ensure `bungee: true` is set in `spigot.yml` (for Spigot) or `velocity: enabled: true` is set in `paper-global.yml` (for Paper/Folia). * **Folia loading error?**: Ensure `folia-supported: true` is present in your `plugin.yml`. * **Library Conflicts?**: AxoCore uses package relocation to avoid conflicts with other plugins, ensuring total system stability. --- ## 👨‍💻 Authors Developed with ❤️ by **Axira Estudio & MiguelTime**.

Need technical support? Reach out through our official channels.
